articles.title: Payments firm OpenPayd targets year-end Nasdaq listing to fund U.S. expansion and acquisitions
articles.summary: CEO Iana Dimitrova said OpenPayd aims to launch in the U.S. by April 2027 and is eyeing deals to add licenses and technology.

articles.title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
articles.summary: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.
